annotation.title_clean: Council Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 of 18 November 2022 on Union support for the implementation of a project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in Artificial Intelligence for Peace and Security'
annotation.title_en: Council Decision (CFSP) 2022/2269 of 18 November 2022 on Union support for the implementation of a project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in Artificial Intelligence for Peace and Security'
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 300/11
annotation.summary_en: EU Council CFSP decision funding (EUR 1.78m) a 36-month UNODA/SIPRI project to engage the civilian AI community in mitigating diversion and misuse of civilian AI by irresponsible actors, through education materials, STEM workshops and multi-stakeholder dialogues. It explicitly creates no new standards or regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Union funds project 'Promoting Responsible Innovation in AI for Peace and Security' with EUR 1,782,285.71.
UNODA, supported by SIPRI, implements it under the High Representative's responsibility.
Project does not establish new standards, principles or regulation; it promotes responsible innovation as self-governance.
Three strands: education materials, university workshops, and multi-stakeholder and industry dialogues.
Decision expires 36 months after the contribution agreement; quarterly reporting to the Council.
